:::{.callout-learning}

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

-   Navigate the basics of the RStudio interface
-   Run code and basic arithmetic in the Console
-   Explain how and why to write code in an R Script
-   Apply built-in R functions and assign values to objects
-   Use the Help pages to look up function documentation
:::
